$comment: RGCompanion's parity with the page (G42.0). Every settings section, Canvas viewer kind, chat item and wire message of the page has a row: app = native | embed | partial | no | n/a, the app's files that do it (paths under apps/companion), the G42 phase that closes it, the study rows (memory/study_g42_parita.md). Checked by packages/web/test/companion-parity.test.ts and apps/companion/test/parity_test.dart.

general.note: Native (G42.4): theme, interface language, agents' language, instructions for all with the PromptRefiner (diff, writer model, tools proposal), backup model, web search, voice messages, images, updates, What's new whenever, debug log, sign out; Safety (guardian, approvals, spending, skills, retention) in Settings › Safety.

system.note: Native (G42.14): the machine (processor, memory, cards, disks, virtual or not), the role asked first with the node's pairing, data and backups (places, disks, a folder, SFTP/SMB/node, the host's steps in a container and Proxmox's «Do it for me», when, how many, a backup now, the backups there restored), Wi-Fi, HTTPS at home with the certificate's QR, SSH, the OS's updates and the restart; the mandatory and breaking updates' gate with the safety backup (update_gate.dart, opened by itself on connect). Disk space shows as the page shows it (the data folder, the disks, a node's free disk); the page has no clean-up or sandbox repair (study rows 284-285: nothing to mirror).

setup.note: Native (G42.17): the page's wizard (Setup.tsx, wizard.ts with its vectors) as SetupWizardScreen: the same steps for every mode, role, local offer and password, the counter with every step, Next/Back/Skip, each step saved when left; role, password, machine, mode, names, safety's ready choices and the summary drawn here, the models, local models, who uses which, import, Telegram, backups, code and access from outside open their native screens from their step. «Redo the setup» in Settings; the app's first start (network, access, languages, a way of thinking, names) ends with «Continue the setup».

agents.note: Native (G42.4): the tree at every level (open and close, projects, assigned, stopped, «Agent under»), the new agent with every step of the page's wizards and God's instructions and tools, assistants' services, routines and skills, the whole agent's settings (read only for an archived project); pause, resume, remove, «Removed agents» (3.8.9). A new routine opens the whole automation editor with the assistant chosen (G42.9); adding a service goes to Extensions (G42.11).

memory.note: Native (G42.10): Settings › Shared memory (the two kinds side by side, learns by itself, add, edit, delete with undo, forget for good, where each came from, space used, the last changes undoable); an agent's own and its project's memory, the way to the shared one and the automatic summaries in its Memory tab.

knowledge.note: Native (G42.10): state of the index with its bar, why the search goes by words only, collections and who they are for, sources (folder, file, web page, project, mailbox, conversations; Rasgeth's folders, files sent from the device, or a path), what was left out, try a search, embedding and rerank models with their download bar, cloud API, threads, OCR, disk, backup of the vectors, Rebuild, Pause; an agent's Knowledge tab with the page's choices; `#kb:` citations open in the app. Files dropped on a card (drag and drop) are not there yet.

automations.note: Native (G42.9): the list with its switch, runs, run now, the webhook's secret shown once, delete; a new automation or reminder; the whole editor (When, Only if, What it does, Where it tells you, Advanced, the YAML in a coloured field, the next times from the server), ported from AutomationEditor.tsx and checked with the page's vectors; the magic automation with God (proposal beside the conversation, needs, approve, change, reject); an assistant's routines with the same editor; the messages in For you, the bell and the system's notifications (push kind automation). The mailboxes are only listed (added in Channels and mailboxes, G42.13).

extensions.note: Native (G42.11): the magic integration and extension with God (the package beside the conversation, its parts with their arguments and tests, the hosts it reaches, the missing key added in its window into the keychain or given to the package after a yes, approve, test again, reject with a reason, change, uninstall); the agents' proposals read in full (a new version with its line, word by word, its scripts) and decided, also in the bell and in For you; the services connected with their state (signing in opens the service's page in the system's browser, then the state is read again until it works), sign in again, remove; the generation (the model's own tool, who makes each kind, its key with where to get it, the model and the voice); the catalog (the protocol's MCP_CATALOG and catalogConfig, checked with its vectors: search, kinds, official first, the guide with the return address to copy, the person's own app, the fields, the key); the installed skills and tools (versions, download as .zip, open the file); a skill's .zip imported (asked before replacing), a skill written, an MCP server by address or command. No brand logos: the kinds' drawn icons. 3.9.7: Settings › Skills (skills_screen.dart) stays as a shortcut.

keychain.note: Native (G42.12): the list with search and kinds, how it is sealed, what expires soon; the keys a part of Rasgeth uses (usedBy: «Used by» with its page, never deleted here) and the ones it keeps elsewhere (system, set by the administrator when locked); a credential's window (service and name, kind, user, address, the value shown or copied only after our window and dropped when hidden or closed, the clipboard emptied after 30 s, the generator, where it may go, who may use it, agents, tools and automations, when to ask, expiry, labels, notes, the header), its last uses; importing a password manager's CSV (preview, the rows kept) or a sealed file, the sealed export; the browsers linked with a code, unlinked after a yes; a secret held back in the composer put in the keychain («Put it in the keychain»), a magic automation's missing key added from its need. The device's own unlock (biometrics) is not there yet: the plugin is not in the app.

telegram.note: Native (G42.13): the three steps on a path (BotFather, the token tried by the server, the bot opened with the pairing code) with the chat Telegram will show (beside them on a computer, inside the step on a phone), the linked accounts with Unlink, «Change bot», set by the administrator. The QR of the bot's link is not drawn in the app (the link opens Telegram directly).

chats.note: Native (G42.13): Discord, Slack, Signal, WhatsApp, Matrix, Microsoft Teams and iMessage as squares lit when on, each window with what it needs and the numbered steps, the code to send, the accounts with Unlink, Teams' app saved to the device, Turn off and Change; the mailboxes in Settings › Automations as on the page: the single one of before, then many by category, added, changed (the password stays unless a new one is written) and removed, tried by the server.

budgets.note: Native (G42.4): this month's total with its days, everything, each project and agent with their limit; the limit's window with the wizard's amounts, another amount or no limit.

subscriptions.note: Native (G42.15): the ways of thinking as squares (Claude signed in from the browser with the code pasted back, ChatGPT with the device code, an API key per provider tried by the server, the own server), the default model with its effort, who uses which model (God, Demi-God, the assistants, the others, the backup) in the one model sheet by provider and way with the newest first and a search (2026-11-20), the model on this computer (the machine, the engine, the models that run well and the slower ones with the estimated speed, the download with its bar, pause and go on, start, on and off, use for the agents, the speed test, delete, the other files and Downloaded models). Not yet in the app: SSD stream and its options, moving the models to another disk, Hugging Face search, speculative decoding, the tuning table, the catalog row; web search stays in General (G42.4). The request inspector (row 273) is not a page feature: n/a.

code.note: G42.5: Settings › Code as the page's CodeSettings and GitCode.tsx: GitHub and Gitea as two tiles lit when linked, each with its window (GitHub's guide for a fine-grained token, «Try and save», «Disconnect»; Gitea started here with its job followed step by step and the image's download bar, or one the person has, with the page's words when its name or address does not answer; «Open Gitea», «Switch off»), and «Create the repositories now» with each project's outcome. Same routes; nothing kept in the app.

remote.note: Native (G42.14): the password (the others signed out on a yes), the authenticator's code with its QR, sign out everywhere, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel and one's own domain with the job followed, the address with its QR and Switch off, one's own infrastructure (blocks filled by the page's own-infra rules, checked with vectors), «Try a name», «reachable already», Pi-hole.

backup.note: Native (G42.14): the backup file made with its steps, saved with its bar, the keychain sealed with a passphrase; a file sent with its bar, its preview, the names chosen, imported; the destinations (SFTP, SMB, node, the host's disks, Proxmox) in Settings › System.

platform.note: Native (G42.17): the history of changes in sentences (changes.ts's describeChange with its vectors), undo, God's code changes with discard and promote (asked first, only when supervised), technical details, how the server runs and its releases.

tools.note: Native (G42.4): the common tools with their cost, search, the essential ones locked, exceptions per agent back to «As for everyone», the extensions' tools; one agent's tools in its settings and when it is made. 3.9.4: the tool groups (off by default, always on, off by you) with their cost, for every agent and in an agent's settings (ToolKitsSection, AgentKits).

import.note: Native (G42.17): look on this computer (home, projects, a folder) or upload a folder or an export; everything found by kind with its switch, what is already here, the notes and what is left behind; the server's job, undo, the memories offer; the history of imports with undo.

commands.note: Native (G42.4): one page as the page's Settings › Commands: agents at work together with the live queue, background commands, normal commands, steps.

requests.note: Native (G42.4): ask me or don't ask me anything (the classifier and its model), the time to answer and what happens after it, the truly dangerous requests, the classifier's decisions; answering requests in Inbox.

projects.note: Project list with git state (advanced interface); 3.8.8: a click shows the project's conversations (its lead's and its team's; archived, read only with its tasks), its menu archives it (the page's window: who works, the automations that pause), restores it and initialises git; the full Settings › Projects page only in «All settings». 2026-11-18: «Agenti al massimo in questo progetto» (0-10, default 3) native: in the project's menu (its window) and in the project's view, the same slider, rule and words as the page's Settings › Projects.

artifacts.note: Settings of the server › Artifacts: by place, facts, permissions (grant with a cap, take back), open, export (.rgartifact with or without its data, or HTML), delete, import into a place; capability sentences from the protocol's vectors.

acp.note: Native (G42.17): the external agents with their command, project and state; add from the server's ready commands or another program, try, edit command, arguments and variables (secrets refused by the server), remove after a yes.

machines.note: Native (G42.14): add and change (secrets kept unless new ones are written), the public key to copy, the test with the first key trusted and a changed key replaced only after a yes, a new key, who may use it, remove.

nodes.note: Native (G42.14): this machine's name and fingerprint, the code for ten minutes, the pairs waiting with their six digits and both fingerprints, the tree with state, capabilities and who may command it, rename and unpair on a yes, grants and Take away, pairing under another machine, where each project's commands, backups and videos go. Never a pair without the person's yes on both screens.

devices.note: Native: list, rename (G42.4), revoke and push test.

voice.note: Native (G42.16): who reads aloud, volume and press-and-talk (G40.10); hands-free as the page's voice/* (the state machine, the VAD, the wake word's spelling and checks, what is read of an answer, ported with the page's vectors), the indicator at the top (phone band, conversation header, computer's bar) with Talk now, Stop, Switch off, Settings › Voice's hands-free part (on this device, wake word of one's own checked by the server, sensitivity, language, who writes down with General's panel, follow-up, barge-in, where it goes), Android's foreground service while it listens. The wake word (3.10.2): Vosk on the device through dart:ffi with the page's grammar and classifyHeard (Android carries libvosk, Windows and Linux download alphacephei's release checked by SHA-256), the model from the server's job and file with a real bar, only when asked; macOS and iOS keep Talk now and say so.

portrait.note: Native (3.9.4): Settings › Portrait («Mirror»): on/off, who reads it, the traits grouped with how sure and where each comes from (the conversation opens), change with category, remove, not true, add by hand, the text the agents read, forget everything.

document.note: The page's viewer and editor through embed=canvas inside the native frame. Documents and slides open the embed isolated as a whole (/embed-isolated.html, COOP/COEP): LibreOffice's frame has SharedArrayBuffer in WKWebView and WebKitGTK too (G42.8: Playwright WebKit and the Linux app), Chromium web views also through Document-Isolation-Policy. The engine comes down the first time with the page's bar (amounts, speed, time left, «Annulla», «Riprova») into the web view's storage (rg-zeta-*); Export as, PDF to print, the original's kept versions and Find/Replace through the page, their «Save as…» over the bridge. On a phone the pages as printed with Find and Replace (as the page). Where the engine still cannot start the page says why in the app's words and «Open in the browser» opens Rasgeth's page with the file in its Canvas. Linux (WebKitGTK in the app): the embed is isolated but its workers have no WebGL, so LibreOffice does not start: the pages as printed with Find and Replace, and the page's sentence sends to «Open in the browser». macOS and iOS (WKWebView, WebGL in workers since Safari 17) to confirm on a device; a phone sees the pages as in the page.

timeline.note: A video timeline (.rgvideo, G41.5b-G41.7, 3.10): the page's VideoEditor through embed=canvas inside the native frame like the other editors, with the phone layout of G41.5c below 560 px; G42.18: J, K, L, I, O and Ctrl/Cmd+B passed on from the app's part of the Canvas to a timeline only (never while typing), a file of the native tree dropped on it placed on the track under the pointer (`drop`), a render started in it followed in the system's notifications with its bar (`job`, GET /api/jobs/:id, also after the tab is closed), «Ask the agent here» into the conversation's composer, «Save as…» of the finished video and of the XML for Resolve through the app's dialog, the «Video timeline» kind word. 3.10, video part 2 (G41.20), with the page in the same view: speed and still frames, picture in picture with keyframes, colour and .cube LUTs, volume keyframes, the music's beats and «Taglia a ritmo», slip/slide/roll with the T tool, Resolve's FCP7 XML imported by the agent (in the page too only through the agent, as the .otio). App shots on a timeline with a box, keys, colour and beats: rg-test/video-3100/app-shots-part2.

explorer.note: The top bar's folder (Explorer.tsx): the conversation's place (project, personal agents' desk or platform, as currentScope), new file and folder, upload with keep both / replace, .rgartifact import, hidden files, refresh, terminal, rename, download, delete to .trash, copy path, ask the agent, open in the Canvas, search; archived projects read only. Phone: a screen of its own. A subproject's agent opens it on the subproject's folder (G24.13, the page's focus), and each subproject has its files button. «Terminal» (G42.5): any place but an archived project; on a computer a tab in the conversation's right column, on a phone the whole screen.

terminal.note: The page's TerminalView.tsx over /term, drawn natively by xterm 4.0.0 (MIT, pinned): full-screen programs, colours (the page's theme over xterm.js's palette), cursor and mouse modes, the size measured in hello and on resize, the page's red error and grey «closed» lines, «Open again». Computer: tabs in the conversation's right column beside the files and the Canvas (closed by their ×), Ctrl+Shift+C copies and Ctrl+V pastes, every other key to the program; also the advanced views. Phone: the whole screen with the keys row (Esc, Tab, Ctrl and Alt held for the next key, arrows, Home/End, PgUp/PgDn, | ~ / -, paste, keyboard) and text size.

canvas.note: The Canvas's frame (SideArea.tsx and Canvas.tsx's head): tabs with «Chat» and «Maximize», the bar (name, kind and weight from title, save state, the agent's move, the tab's own buttons from bar, keyboard map, reload, download, full screen, open outside), the divider; on a phone the Canvas screen with the same tabs. A few web views alive together (three, two on a phone, one on Linux), the others loaded again on return. Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed to the page.

subagentSign.note: A sub-agent's sign instead of a mascot (decision of 2026-11-19, board choice A): the ring in its parent's colour, the same drawing as the page's subagentSignSvg (Mascot.tsx), checked pixel by pixel against the library (test/subagent_sign_test.dart). Every MascotView of a sub-agent shows it: tabs, team, Room, approvals, the computer's rail and lists.
